title: Paint the Dungeon Green
description: Paint the Dungeon Green — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Kent the Artisan

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Sir Kent says that, believe it or not, Oroks are really pink! They carry green paint to touch themselves up. Collect the following things from enemies in Algernon:

  • 7 cans of green paint, by killing Oroks in Orok Outpost.

Quest Reward: 750 Gold + 1 KC

Return to:Sir Kent the Artisan

Repeatable: No
